question: Should `plugin.approval.resolved` use `decision: null` as the permanent cancellation contract for all plugin approval consumers?
rationale: This PR changes a public plugin/channel contract while fixing a security-sensitive approval cleanup bug, and automation should not choose the API direction on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Complete nullable cancel contract
options.body: Make `decision: null` the supported cancellation event across all plugin approval waiters, SDK types, docs/tests, and channel renderers before merge.

options.title: Choose a different cancellation shape
options.body: Keep this PR paused while maintainers pick a non-null cancellation status or separate event and update consumers around that contract.

options.title: Land only the narrow path knowingly
options.body: Accept the before_tool_call-only cleanup as partial and keep the linked issue open for Codex app-server/native-hook follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Complete nullable cancel contract
recommendation.body: Make `decision: null` the supported cancellation event across all plugin approval waiters, SDK types, docs/tests, and channel renderers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The original merged plugin approval stack and hardening commits make this the strongest routing candidate for the public approval contract choice.
